His reply was – Book all the hotels and other travels reservations and come to me. At the same time we approached 2-3 other travel agents, they immediate replied to us that Rome Visa is not possible, there are no available for 2-3 months. Other travel agents suggested applying from other countries to get Schengen. Mr Joseph was clueless that Italy is not having open dates to Visa.
After going home I tried calling Joseph and to again reconfirm if dates are available with him as he was the only agant who agreed to apply visa from Italian consulate. His team picked up the call and told us cleraly that Mr Joseph is busy and he will callback. I never received callback.
Since I was him 4-5 times, Joseph told his team to inform me that I wont be doing your Visa. This is the 1st Visa agant I met who is not concerned with customers not coming to him, his attitude and ego has the topmost priority.
Me and my wife visited his place once again to try our luck with Mr Rude. To our shock, he bluntly left the place by seeing us. He mentioned there is some urgent thing has come up. His staff promised us to callback and give appointment as and when Mr Joseph is back. As expected we never got a callback and when we visited the office again Joseph was busy attending other customers.
Eventually after such terrible experience with this man, he told us it is not possible for you to get Visa. Whereas other tavel agants had tons of other options to get Visa.
We got the Visa well in advance of of travel date. Had we applied visa from Joseph, we would have left in depsair and frustation.
Stay away people, this man has no knowledge and he is not updated on Visa date status of all the coutries. All he cares is about his attitude. I really pity the staff who work there as well, they are always scared of what this man is going to say. The team sitting there is all the time in fear of this man shouting at them

I was finally able to find out the contact details of Nilesh Sharma, Operation Head JMM Travel & Tour Co. I explained to him that I was a returning customer and was very interested in using them again. But sadly nothing worked and I finally decided to move on. It is best to avoid this agency as soliciting even a courtesy response is going to be a wild goose chase. If one as to chase this agency just to give them business then you can imagine how responsive they are going to be once they have your money.
In the meantime I was able to find a great alternative and had a great trip to Kerala. I will be positing my review for that in a few days.
